usedFor: AnnounceKit publishes the product updates, and Google Docs receives them as text through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new post is created” in AnnounceKit, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: New posts are the announcements themselves, so each one can land as text in a tab you pick.

watchOut: “When a new post is created” is polling, so the Doc tab updates after a scheduled check.
